note: Synthetic. Two notices: one for everybody, one that concerns no student at all.

items.title: Circular - Declaration of holiday on account of local festival
items.body: All affiliated colleges shall observe a holiday on 17 September 2026. Classes will resume the following working day.

items.title: Notification - Invitation of tenders for campus housekeeping services
items.body: Sealed tenders are invited from registered agencies for housekeeping at the regional centre.
